spans.s: hitaṃkara, adj. (= Skt. and Pali hitakara; only in vss, perh. m.c.), beneficent: ˚raḥ LV 〔359.9〕 (vs); ˚rāḥ Suv 〔159.9〕 (vs). Cf. next.

Hiteṣin, Hitaiṣin (both spellings in mss.), n. of three former Buddhas in the same list: Mv 〔iii.234.7〕; 〔236.11〕; 〔237.5〕.
